.create-or-alter function with (folder = "Agent", docstring = "Average day-ahead price (ct/kWh and EUR/MWh) per renewable-share band, plus one row 'Total (all quarter-hours)' with the overall weighted average price, the total number of quarter-hours and the overall correlation between renewable share and price, for the last <lookback> (default 30 days). Use this for any question about how the electricity price depends on the renewable share.")
PriceVsRenewableShare(lookback: timespan = 30d) {
    let base = LoadAndShare()
        | where ts > ago(lookback)
        | join kind=inner (DayAheadPrice() | where ts > ago(lookback) | project ts, Price_ct_kWh) on ts;
    let bands = base
        | extend RenewableBand = case(RenewableShare_Pct >= 100, "5: 100 % and more",
                                      RenewableShare_Pct >= 80,  "4: 80–100 %",
                                      RenewableShare_Pct >= 60,  "3: 60–80 %",
                                      RenewableShare_Pct >= 40,  "2: 40–60 %",
                                                                 "1: below 40 %")
        | summarize Avg_ct_kWh = round(avg(Price_ct_kWh), 2),
                    Avg_EUR_MWh = round(avg(Price_ct_kWh) * 10, 1),
                    QuarterHours = count(),
                    From_local = min(Time_local), To_local = max(Time_local)
            by RenewableBand;
    let total = base
        | summarize n = count(),
                    sx = sum(RenewableShare_Pct), sy = sum(Price_ct_kWh),
                    sxy = sum(RenewableShare_Pct * Price_ct_kWh),
                    sxx = sum(RenewableShare_Pct * RenewableShare_Pct),
                    syy = sum(Price_ct_kWh * Price_ct_kWh),
                    From_local = min(Time_local), To_local = max(Time_local)
        | project RenewableBand = "6: Total (all quarter-hours)",
                  Avg_ct_kWh = round(sy / n, 2),
                  Avg_EUR_MWh = round(sy / n * 10, 1),
                  QuarterHours = n,
                  Correlation = round((n * sxy - sx * sy) / sqrt((n * sxx - sx * sx) * (n * syy - sy * sy)), 2),
                  From_local, To_local;
    union bands, total
    | project RenewableBand, Avg_ct_kWh, Avg_EUR_MWh, QuarterHours, Correlation, From_local, To_local
    | order by RenewableBand asc
}


DayAheadPrice()
| where Time_local >= datetime(2026-10-09) and ts <= now()
| summarize NegativeQuarterHours = countif(Price_ct_kWh < 0),
            Min_ct_kWh = min(Price_ct_kWh),
            Max_ct_kWh = max(Price_ct_kWh)
